items.title: Physical AI Empowers Smart Mobility: LUXEED Builds a New Full-Scenario Intelligent Ecosystem
items.summary: WUHU, China, Nov. 06, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Earlier this year, Chery Automobile established a global strategic partnership with NVIDIA to conduct joint R&D across high-level driver assistance, in-cabin AI, and robotics, accelerating the industrial deployment of Physical AI. As Physical AI rapidly transitions from virtual models to real-world applications, the automobile is being redefined into an intelligent entity capable of perception, comprehension, and decision-making.
